headline: Freelancers' Income in the Republic of Moldova Rose by Almost 12% in July
summary: Freelancers in Moldova recorded income of 46.1 million lei in July 2026, 11.97% above June. A single tax of nearly 6.9 million lei was calculated on this income, according to the State Fiscal Service.
why: Freelancer income and tax receipts are indicators of activity in the services economy and feed into fiscal revenue tracking. Trends in this segment reflect the informal and digital labour market.
